# Mobile presentation assets

These are pinned consumer assets for Open Sesame’s mobile presentation. OpenCoven’s [canonical public-web profile](https://github.com/OpenCoven/brand/blob/798e2f5f2f1a69f5d156ccc0a9aafc4f7da55fc8/web/profile.json) retains brand authority. This directory does not define another canonical profile. Product-specific serif/sans roles follow issue #33’s EB Garamond/Inter direction; the exact v0.3 reference still belongs to dependency #34.

[provenance.json](provenance.json) records immutable upstream URLs, SHA-256 digests and byte lengths. All font, mark and notice bytes are unmodified. Fonts come from `google/fonts` revision `5bb28733cec313b63fbd415b574b5ae35c8aa8b8`: EB Garamond regular/italic variable weight and Inter regular variable optical-size/weight. The complete copyright and SIL Open Font License 1.1 notices are retained as [EB-Garamond-OFL.txt](EB-Garamond-OFL.txt) and [Inter-OFL.txt](Inter-OFL.txt). No subsetting, renaming of the upstream fonts, outline conversion or binary transformation was performed. The local CSS family names distinguish the consumer scope; each font falls back to a system serif or sans and uses `font-display: swap`.

[opencoven-mark.svg](opencoven-mark.svg) is the byte-exact canonical `web/assets/mark.svg` from `OpenCoven/brand` revision `798e2f5f2f1a69f5d156ccc0a9aafc4f7da55fc8`. It preserves the `0 0 212 212` viewBox, path/transform and monochrome `currentColor`; it is not redrawn or stretched. Brand assets are © OpenCoven and subject to the upstream usage terms, not the font OFL. The upstream README and usage document are retained byte-for-byte as [BRAND-README.txt](BRAND-README.txt) and [BRAND-USAGE.txt](BRAND-USAGE.txt); their relative paths refer to the upstream repository. The newer canonical web-profile/README identify `web/assets/mark.svg` as the current mark, superseding historical compatibility paths. This use is within OpenCoven’s own Open Sesame product.

The header loads the pinned SVG symbol and styles it through inherited monochrome color. Font and mark URL content hashes match delivered bytes. Run [the asset check](../../../scripts/check-mobile-assets.mjs) and the existing asset-cache and branding checks before changing these files. Asset-byte provenance is separate from visual parity, browser acceptance and real-device qualification.

The mobile presentation also follows the supplied v0.3 specimen: source ZIP SHA-256 `5d4fc2401534ddf2350edc529c874bc26bdcaa695c1c66e3509fb38fe7d60274`, standalone HTML SHA-256 `f9fbd88673b3cdfc754540ad864fd58c34b47498bbae95c8e5d0555fb7de281a`. The doorway path geometry and diamond/seal styling are derived from that product UI study, with scoped selectors in `mobile-shell.css` and static trusted SVG in `mobile-shell.js`. The prototype script, storage, demo roster and fixtures are not production dependencies. Dependency #34 owns preservation of the original specimen; its source files are separate from these production consumer assets.
